method: Design-point rows are ranked by absolute payload change. Margin-only terms are resized at the design density, because a frozen geometry does not change mass. Gamma and Q on the design point are the admissible floors, so their optimism factor is 1.

analysis. Optimistic weather adds QWEATHER, QWIND and the mass headroom. ISA at the design geometry still floats.
